title: Price increase simulation
statementMd:
Raise the price of every Home product by 5%, then list the Home products with their new prices rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `name`, `price`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
UPDATE products SET price = price * 1.05 WHERE category = 'Home'; SELECT name, ROUND(price, 2) AS price FROM products WHERE category = 'Home';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
